title: King's Quest: Quest for the Crown
shortDescription: Roberta Williams' pioneering animated graphic adventure following Sir Graham seeking three treasures of Daventry.
historicalSignificance: Invented the modern 3D animated graphic adventure game and established Sierra On-Line as a PC giant.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
